title: Preparation and Genetic Transformation of Parastagonospora nodorum Protoplasts
author: Mitt Coats
materials: Prepare the following solutions: Stock solutions (do not filter sterilise) A. 50 mL 1.2 M MgSO 4 .7H 2 O (14.8 g / 50mL) B. 20 mL 1.2M Sorbitol (4.32 g / 20 mL) C. 1 M Tris pH 7.5 2 D. 1 mL 1M CaCl 2 (0.147 g / mL) 3 Wash solution 600 mM MgSO 4 50 mL (~50 mL required per prep) Add 25 mL Soln A to 25 mL milliQ water. Filter sterilise into sterile 50 ml tube. Glucanex solution 1.2 M MgSO 4 , 10 mM phosphate buffer pH 5.8 25 mL per prep Add 0.04g NaH 2 PO 4 to 20 mL soln A and adjust pH to 5.8 using NaOH. Add the NaOH drop by drop. A precipitate will form after each drop but will go back into solution after a couple of minutes stirring. What until precipitate has dissolved before recording pH and re-adjusting if required. Once pH is correct, make up volume to 25 mL with remaining soln A. Do not filter sterilise at this point. On the morning of the transformation, add 0.375 g glucanex to the solution and shake well to resuspend. The solution can now be filter sterilised. Protoplast overlay solution 600 mM Sorbitol, 10 Tris pH 7.5 5 mL per prep Add 2.5 mL of soln B to 2.45 mL milliQ water and 50 ul soln C. Filter sterilise. 1 M Sorbitol-tris solution 2 1 M Sorbitol, 10 Tris pH 7.5 5 mL per prep Add 4.17 mL soln B to 780 ul milliQ water and 50 uL soln C. Filter sterilse. STC buffer 2,3 1.2 M Sorbitol, 10 mM CaCl 2 , 10 Tris pH 7.5 10 mL (~10 mL required per prep) Add 9.8 mL soln B to 100 uL soln C and 100 uL soln D. Filter sterilise 60% PEG solution 2,3 60% PEG-4000, 10 mM CaCl 2 , 10 Tris pH 7.5 (5 mL generally enough for 3 preps) Add 6 g PEG 4000 (BDH only) to 5.3 mL milliQ water, 100 ul soln C and 100 uL soln D. Filter sterilise. Note that 1.2 mL is required for each transformation and thus all 10 mL is not likely to be needed. (Glucanex) Lysing Enzymes from Trichoderma harzianum Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #L1412-10G

steps.title: Prepare overnight culture and plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the fungal culture and agar plates on Day 1.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 100 mL CzV8CS liquid medium (250 mL flask) with a concentrated spore suspension (~10^8 spores).
Incubate the culture at 22ºC with shaking at 140 rpm.
Prepare at least 6 CzV8Cs plates per transformation.

steps.title: Harvest and wash mycelium
steps.instruction: Harvest the mycelium on Day 2 and perform initial washes.

substeps.instruction: Harvest mycelium by centrifugation in sterile 50 mL tubes at 4,000 g for 5 min at 4ºC using a benchtop centrifuge with a swing-out rotor.
Remove supernatant and wash mycelium with ~50 mL filter-sterile 600 mM MgSO4.
Centrifuge again at 4,000 g for 5 min at 4ºC.
Filter sterilize the glucanex solution.

steps.title: Spheroplast generation
steps.instruction: Treat mycelium with glucanex to generate protoplasts.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend mycelium in one 50 mL tube with 25 mL filter-sterile glucanex solution.
Incubate for 2h without agitation at 28ºC in a sterile Petri dish.
During incubation, melt the top agar and cool it in a 50ºC waterbath.

steps.title: Purify and concentrate protoplasts
steps.instruction: Isolate and wash the protoplasts using centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Gently pour protoplasts into a 50 mL sterile tube (do not pipette).
Gently overlay with 5 mL 600 mM sorbitol, 10 mM Tris, pH 7.5.
Centrifuge at 4,000 g for 15 min at 4ºC.
Carefully remove protoplasts from the interface using a 1 mL pipet into a sterile 10 mL tube.
Add an equal volume of 1 M sorbitol, 10 mM Tris, pH 7.5, mix gently, and centrifuge at 1,500 g for 5 min at 4ºC.
Wash protoplasts with 3 mL STC buffer (1,500 g/5 min/4ºC).
Resuspend protoplasts in 0.5 mL STC buffer using inversion and place on ice.

steps.title: Quantify and dilute protoplasts
steps.instruction: Count and standardize the protoplast concentration.

substeps.instruction: Count protoplasts using 1:100 or 1:250 dilutions in STC.
Dilute protoplasts to a concentration of 5×10^8/mL.
Allocate 100 µL of the diluted protoplasts for subsequent transformations.

steps.title: DNA transformation
steps.instruction: Introduce DNA into the protoplasts using PEG.

substeps.instruction: Add prepared DNA (3 µg for PCR product or 7.5 µg for linearized construct in a volume up to 125 µL in STC) to 100 µL protoplasts in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Mix very gently by inversion and incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Prepare a control by adding an equal volume of STC buffer without DNA.
Dispense pre-warmed top agar into 5 mL aliquots in sterile 10 mL tubes and keep at 50ºC (4 tubes per transformation, 2 per control).
Add 200 µL 60% PEG solution to the mix and mix by inversion.
Add another 200 µL 60% PEG solution, then a final 800 µL 60% PEG solution, mixing by inversion and gentle agitation after each addition.
Incubate at room temperature for 15-20 min.

steps.title: Plating and incubation
steps.instruction: Plate the transformation mixture onto agar.

substeps.instruction: Transfer approximately 300-350 µL (one quarter) of the transformation mix to 10 mL pre-warmed (50ºC) CzV8-top agar, mix, and pour onto CzV8 plates pre-warmed to room temperature.
Repeat until 4 plates are poured for the transformation and 2 plates for the control.
Wrap plates in aluminum foil and incubate in the dark at 22ºC.

steps.title: Antibiotic overlay
steps.instruction: Apply selective pressure using antibiotic-containing agar.

substeps.instruction: Melt a second bottle of CzV8-top agar and cool to 50ºC.
Prepare 60 mL of overlay agar at 3x the required final concentration (3x Phleomycin = 250 mg/mL, 0.6 µL/mL of overlay, total 36 µL; 3x Hygromycin = 100 mg/mL, 6 µL/mL of overlay, total 360 µL).
Apply 10 mL of the antibiotic overlay to each transformed plate (~40h after transformation for hyg, 24h for phleo).
Pour 10 mL overlay on one control plate; leave the second control plate without overlay.
Wrap plates in foil and incubate until mycelium appears.

steps.title: Sub-culture colonies
steps.instruction: Isolate appearing colonies between one and three weeks.
